description: V-JEPA 2-AC (Assran et al. 2025, arXiv:2506.09985) external zero-shot reference for ICLR2027_PLAN.md E2; used by scripts/v2/eval_vjepa2ac.py

repo.note: src/hub/backbones.py at this commit points VJEPA_BASE_URL at localhost; weights are loaded from the local file below instead of torch.hub. timm (only drop_path) is shimmed if absent.

checkpoint.name: vjepa2-ac-vitg (ViT-g/16 encoder 1012.2M params + AC predictor 305.2M params, 256px, tubelet 2)
checkpoint.key_check: encoder 484/484 and predictor 300/300 tensors match _make_vjepa2_ac_model(vit_ac_giant, 256px) names and shapes exactly; encoder == target_encoder (spot-checked)

training_data_caveat: V-JEPA 2-AC was post-trained on raw DROID trajectories (droid_train_paths.csv, not released; config camera_views=[left_mp4_path], fps=4, 8 frames/clip). Our test episodes come from DROID 1.0.0 RLDS (r2d2_faceblur-train shards); overlap with its training trajectories cannot be ruled out and is likely.
